title: The Problem With Human Rights
summary: A philosophy video critiquing the concept of human rights from a Marxist perspective, drawing on Locke, Marx, Nietzsche, Hegel and Rawls. It examines what human rights actually mean and presuppose.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a deeper philosophical look at human rights from a critical Marxist angle.
